name: Anthropic
short: Claude models direct from Anthropic's API; pay-as-you-go from $0.10/$0.50 per 1M (Haiku 5.5, prompts ≤100K) up to $10/$50 per 1M (Fable class), with a 50% Batch API discount and a free consumer tier (Claude app).

plans.name: Free (Claude app)
